title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Last summer, Lucas and his father took a trip to the mountains. They walked along a narrow path next to a river. At the top of the hill, they saw a beautiful lake and many birds in the sky.

That night, they slept in a small tent near the water. They cooked soup on a little stove and talked about their adventure. Lucas said it was the best trip of his life, and his father agreed.

questions.text: Where did Lucas and his father go last summer?
What did they cook on the little stove?
Why did Lucas and his father walk along the path?
options: They wanted to reach the top of the hill and see the view
They were looking for a shop
They were lost in the city
They wanted to swim in the river

questions.text: How did Lucas feel about the trip?
options: He was bored and wanted to go home
He was angry with his father
He was very happy with the adventure
He was afraid of the birds

vocabulary.definition: very high areas of land with steep sides
an exciting experience, often with some risk
a portable shelter made of cloth

paragraph_translations: El verano pasado, Lucas y su padre hicieron un viaje a las montañas. Caminaron por un sendero estrecho junto a un río. En la cima de la colina vieron un lago hermoso y muchos pájaros en el cielo.

Esa noche durmieron en una tienda pequeña cerca del agua. Cocinaron sopa en una estufa pequeña y hablaron sobre su aventura. Lucas dijo que era el mejor viaje de su vida, y su padre estuvo de acuerdo.
